body:
Ok, well one day I found my self with a lab bottle full of ether, I had done ether before but never in such large quantities.
I remember it was a Monday afternoon when I got the stuff, at night I decided to give it a try.
I wet a piece of cloth on the liquid ether and started inhaling... As I expected from my past experiences the experience effects started immediately, I kept inhaling for a while, after some time I started hearing and seeing things 4 times, like in some sort of conscious drunken state. When I felt this I immediately stopped thinking these where the peak effects, the effects passed by the next 15 minutes or so, the I decided to give it another shot... This time I was aught in the middle of a loops within a loop of images and sounds, It was like being inside a mirror cube. Things kept going on like this for what I think was about 30 minutes, then I inhaled some more and found myself inside infinity, I was a part of it and felt horrible because I had forgotten reality and there was no end to the loops.
The effects went away and since then most of my ether trips are similar to the one I described.
